name: hexy-portrait-rally-clean
prompt: Re-layout these exact FOUR illustrated Hexy portraits in a TWO by TWO grid, preserving the faces, expressions, two-arm anatomy and gestures in each drawing. Every figure must be complete and SHRUNK to occupy only the CENTRAL 70 PERCENT of its own quadrant. The remaining THIRTY PERCENT must be completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters, especially between neighbors and on the outer right and left edges. RESTORE every cropped hair lock, hat tip and wand star before placing figures inside those broad empty gutters. No part of any figure may touch the canvas edge or a neighbor. Same youthful detailed anime cartoon style and exactly TWO arms per Hexy, ONE wand. Do not invent or duplicate any arms. FOUR figures, TWO columns and TWO rows, full hat and all wand stars/hair/arms within each cell. True alpha transparency, no colored glow background, no gradient, no checkerboard. The empty outer transparent border must be visually obvious.
